IconsCXL quality audit · 16 November 2026

Every current name has an individual visual assessment. Previews use current SVGs; the JSON ledger binds verdicts to reviewed SHA-256 hashes. Native evidence covers 16/24/32 points, both tints, 1×/2×. Browser previews are not native-rendering evidence.
